deals.owner_email.reason: Optional. Opportunity has no readable owner field. Account.Owner_Email__c is the account owner, not the deal owner, so it is not used. Left unmapped.

deals.stage.reason: Standard Stage picklist, required. All 6 values map to the target stage enum; rule test passed 50/50. The custom Stage__c (Commit, Pipeline, Best Case, Omitted) is a forecast category with no target field, so it is not used.
